joinedToolExecutionOrdering: All14 endpoints pass individually, but complete actual target declaration order is rejected. This is an additional whole-domain obligation, not another endpoint failure or new V66 regression.
sourceProvenanceLimit: Verified .89 forkedAgent source is already byte-identical to current and does not repair its four .90 endpoint failures; ASThelper and toolHooks have distinct donor deltas requiring separate source gates.
callerAndInitializationLimits: Exactly two direct validator callers, one classifier caller and indirect extraction/autoDream authorization paths are retained.
Concurrency invocation catches return false; schema parsing outside those catches remains separate. UI rejection handling does not establish authorization safety.
Permission rejection can become an error tool result, with sibling_error cancellation excluded from parent propagation; speculation cleanup is not guaranteed.
The four-owner readOnly/BashTool/permission/path cycle and latch-cleared-before-callback helper retain partial-readiness/reentry limits.
One StreamingToolExecutor canUseTool property lacks exact start mapping; dynamic object aliases and replaced methods are outside lexical scope.
Null-module direct access, sparse/exotic argv and reordered constructor/filter/RegExp evaluation remain observable limits.
shellQuotePackageEffects: Conditional Linux/macOS sandbox paths still reach shell-quote package parser initialization and four random-token iterations; V65 wrapper removal is not global initializer erasure.

differenceMetadataQualification.modelFieldsMeaning: Differences inside model.fields only; model.graph and model.nodes are separate.
differenceMetadataQualification.firstPathsMeaning: Up to five paths relative to the raw AST, model.fields, model.graph or full scope object respectively.
